question: When was the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana launched by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana** was launched by the Government of India in 2016.
 
• It is a social welfare scheme launched by the Government of India to provide free LPG connections to women from below poverty line households.
 
• The aim of the scheme is to empower women and protect their health by providing them with a clean cooking fuel.
 
• The scheme has been successful in reaching out to millions of households across the country and has helped in reducing the health hazards caused by traditional cooking fuels.
 
• The scheme has also helped in reducing the dependence on traditional fuels such as firewood, cow dung, and charcoal, which are not only harmful to health but also contribute to deforestation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Gram LPG Vidarak Yojana (RGGLV) program was introduced by the Indian government on October 16, 2009, with the objective of expanding the use of LPG and setting up distributors in isolated and difficult-to-reach places.
 
• A program to give Below Poverty Line (BPL) households one-time financial help for LPG connections was also introduced by the government in 2009.
 
• Through the government's Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Fund, the support was given.
